hook: Your board is a river: as fish ahead die, the run climbs, and the first home showers its neighbours with stats.
loop: Set the river: who dies at the Source, who waits at B1
In the fight the run Leaps upstream, every mover gaining a Stamp
The fish that came Home Spawns: a lasting Gift, then an Alevin

growth.line: One Stamp per moving fish per fight; each Spawn permanently gives both neighbours +(Stamps plus tier) stats.

feel.early: Small Spawns that already pay; Alevins start triples
feel.mid: Stamps compound; Old Kelt sends a fish home every fight
feel.late: Mother Redd, Bradán or Llyn Llyw: three different finishes

stars.why: Drifts to the mouth; the whole run leaps up behind him
Stamps neighbours, blocks the way home, and Spawns one when sold
Fish stop being spent: the same veteran keeps coming home

card_short.u01: Spawn leftover; grows with each Stamp
card_short.u02: Gains stats this fight when it leaps
card_short.u03: When played: give a Stamp, then stats per Stamp
card_short.u04: No Leap. Stamps fish alongside; sold, Spawns one upstream
card_short.u05: No Leap. Each Spawn adds an Alevin to hand
card_short.u06: Drifts downstream at Start of Combat, starting the climb
card_short.u07: Gives Leap to units alongside, any tribe
card_short.u08: Buffs your units with exactly its Stamp count
card_short.u09: Gains Attack this fight whenever another unit leaps
card_short.u10: Start of Turn: buffs a random Salmon per its Stamps
card_short.u11: Spent: non-Salmon units gain stats per its Stamps
card_short.u12: Alevins keep all their parent's Stamps, plus one
card_short.u13: Once a turn, a Spawn's Gift and Spent happen again
card_short.u14: Every fish reaching the Source comes Home; buffs all
card_short.u15: Leaps make it attack at once; Cleave at 3 Stamps
card_short.u16: Leaping into the front row: Shield and stats
card_short.u17: Spawning fish aren't spent; their Alevin goes to hand
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: replays every Salmon's Gift for this fight
card_short.u19: All your units Leap and gain stats per Stamp

builds.name: The Homecoming
builds.line: Kelt opens the way; spend fish every fight for Gifts and Alevins

builds.name: The Long Road
builds.line: Block B1 so nobody goes home; pile up Stamps for Llyn Llyw

builds.name: The Cascade
builds.line: Fragile unit at the Source; every death pulls the run and powers leapers

liked: All three: Old Kelt and the Bailiff, the seed's picture made into cards
Setting the river each turn is a fresh puzzle; the board moves mid-fight
worries: Mother Redd with Warden and Jack: a golden Alevin and Discover nearly every turn
Old Bradán runs about twice the Tier 6 guide in fight (watch)
changed: Gift now adds the fish's tier, so early homecomings pay
Gift reaches only the two river neighbours, not the whole chain
Old Kelt is now No Leap, staying at the mouth
verdict: A moving-river board for positioning fans, who set the run each turn and send fish home.
